director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions mein equal shares dekhenge—cricket pizza jaisa! Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Achha, Riya! Cricket mein ball ko sab players ke liye barabar baantna ho, toh har ek ko kitna milega? Golu ko bhi sikhayenge.
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Agar 1 roti ko 3 barabar hisson mein baante, har hissa one-third hota hai. 3 mein se 1 hissa kitna?
Riya, tumne 4 bola—shayad tum ek hissa soch rahi ho. Ab batao, 1/3 of 15 pencils mein 15 kis cheez ki sankhya hai?
Riya, 1/3 mein neeche wala number batata hai ki total cheezein kitne equal groups mein baantni hain. Ab tum try karo.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Theek hai Riya, ab fill karo: 1/3 ka matlab 1 of kitne equal groups? Apna answer bolo.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Riya, 6 nahi; fraction ke neeche wala number groups batata hai. Ab 1/3 mein neeche ka number dekhkar bolo: kitne equal groups?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Jaise 1/5 ka matlab 5 barabar groups mein se 1. Toh 1/3 mein total kitne equal groups honge?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Ab isi rule se batao: one-third mein 1, kitne equal groups mein se liya gaya hai?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Woh wala: jawab 3. 8 nahi, Riya; neeche ka number hi total equal groups batata hai. Ek roti ke 4 barabar tukde kiye. Ek tukde ko kya kehte hain?
